# Server Sent Events v1.1.0 - Table of Contents

Lightweight, ultra-fast Server Sent Event parser

## Pages

- [ServerSentEvents](https://server-sent-events.hexdocs.pm/readme.md)
- [CHANGELOG](https://server-sent-events.hexdocs.pm/changelog.md)

- Guides
  - [ServerSentEvents Req Example](https://server-sent-events.hexdocs.pm/usage.md)

## Modules

- [ServerSentEvents](https://server-sent-events.hexdocs.pm/ServerSentEvents.md): This module exposes a streaming decoder for Server Sent Events. See the [official
specification](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/server-sent-events.html) for
details on parsing and interpreting the event stream.
- [ServerSentEvents.Parser](https://server-sent-events.hexdocs.pm/ServerSentEvents.Parser.md): Incremental parser for Server Sent Events streams.
